output.summary: A tropical tree native to Southeast Asia and southern China. Its edible fruit has translucent, sweet, mildly aromatic flesh around a large black seed that creates an eye-like appearance. The flesh is eaten raw or used fresh, dried, preserved or canned in soups, snacks and desserts; the peel and seed are not eaten.
